name: chapelcore/contract
description: ChapelCore contract: JSON Schemas, fixtures and openapi.json that make DOMAIN-MODEL.md machine-checkable. The PHP self-tests run the same files through opis/json-schema that the TypeScript tests run through ajv, so both languages must agree; the PHP core (libs/php/native/core, 1.4) and the Laravel contract suite (1.8) consume these files.
